reportSubtitle: Best Week Again, Lookalike Video Compounds, Show Rate is the New Bottleneck
summary:
Best week of the campaign for the second week in a row: 8 demos at $43.30 CPL on $346 spend. That's 1 more lead than last week (7 at $43.92) at essentially the same CPL, and the new all-time low.

The Lookalike Video story compounded. It produced 6 of the 8 leads at $14.13 CPL, even better than last week's $16.54. Two consecutive weeks under $20 CPL on this ad set means the format and audience pairing is the campaign's clear winner. The other three active ad sets together produced 2 leads at roughly $87 CPL on $262 spend, so cost efficiency outside Lookalike Video looks unchanged from prior weeks.

Funnel-side, modal-open rate jumped to 16.1% (35 modal opens from 217 unique visitors), up from 12.2% last week. Plan signup clicks held at 21 with the paid-tier mix at 48% (5 Pro + 5 Creator), holding the gain from last week's 45% paid share.

The bottleneck this week shifted downstream of the campaign to show rate. We're booking demos at the campaign's best volume ever, but no-shows are eating into the value of those bookings. I sent over an SMS reminder proposal on Apr 23 (carrier-verified US number, automated booking reminders, cost absorbed in retainer). Awaiting approval.

Based on this week's data, I made two changes today (Apr 25): paused Production Static (1 lead in 2 weeks at $175 CPL was a clear failed test) and reallocated within the existing $50/day budget. Lookalike Video moves from $12.50 to $20/day, Lookalike Static and Production Video each move to $15/day. Total spend unchanged. Anna's high-spender user list (~100 paying customers) will become the seed for a new Lookalike Video ad set, building this weekend and launching May 1.

Next week's report will be a Month 1 Review, with 3 weeks of post-restructure data, the new ad set live, and a pre vs post comparison addressing the breakeven question.

findings.title: Lookalike Video Compounded: 6 of 8 Demos at $14.13 CPL
findings.description: Second straight week of sub-$20 CPL on this ad set. Across 2 weeks it has produced 10 of 17 total leads at a blended $15.09 CPL on $151 spend. The other three active ad sets together produced 7 leads over 2 weeks at roughly $80 CPL. The gap is no longer a small-sample fluke.

findings.title: Modal-Open Rate Stepped Up to 16.1%
findings.description: 35 cal_modal_opened events on 217 unique visitors, up from 20 modal opens on 164 visitors last week (12.2%). Both visitor count and modal-open rate moved up together, which usually means higher-intent traffic rather than just more volume.

findings.title: Book a Demo Click Volume Hit a 6-Week High
findings.description: 27 Book a Demo clicks this week, the highest weekly count in the entire dataset (prior peak was 21 in Wk Mar 15). After a Wk Apr 5 dip to 7, demo intent has now recovered above its earlier baseline. Plan signup clicks held flat at 21 with the paid-tier mix at 48%.

actions.title: Investigated Cropped Instagram Ad Creative Anna Flagged
actions.description: Confirmed all AI creative variations are off in Ads Manager. The cropped variant with 'Budgeting / Breakdowns' overlay shouldn't be serving. Watching for further reports and will escalate to Meta if it surfaces again.

actions.title: Proposed SMS Reminder System for Show Rate
actions.description: Sent the team an Apr 23 proposal: carrier-verified US phone number, automated SMS reminders to booked leads, ability to text prospects directly with a personal touch. Cost ($20-$40/mo) absorbed in retainer. Awaiting decision.

actions.title: Paused Production Static and Reallocated Budget Toward Top Performers
actions.description: Effective today (Apr 25): Production Static is paused after producing 1 lead at $175 CPL across 2 weeks. The $12.50/day it was consuming is being absorbed into the other 3 ad sets. New daily budgets: Lookalike Video $20 (up from $12.50), Lookalike Static $15, Production Video $15. Total spend unchanged at $50/day. Wk 8 will partially reflect the new allocation; Month 2 will show the full effect.

actions.title: Queued High-Spender Lookalike Build for Weekend
actions.description: Anna provided a list of FinalBit's highest-spending paying users (~100 contacts). Building a new Lookalike Video ad set with this audience as the seed over the weekend so it has time to populate in Meta. Target launch: May 1, alongside the Month 1 Review. This is theoretically the strongest possible audience for the campaign because the seed is verified buyer data rather than cold prospect data.

Build the high-spender Lookalike Video over the weekend so the audience populates in time for May 1 launch
